items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Blue Pristotnik and Irving Fasola were both here.

ctx.x: No, not Tio. Earl Fink. But, no. This man really won't be, uh. Is it that? Was it with Faye? Or with P-ron? No, he played with P-ron. He played with P-ron. Oh, okay. Well, I could find that, uh. Well, no, then, uh, that was on the color side. Now, on the white side, the, uh, the white color side a couple of years ago. He played with Earl Dan on there for a couple of years. Earl Dan had the band on for two or three years.
Oh, uh, Blue was on. Fasola, Fasola, yeah. Blue Pristotnik and Irving Fasola were both here.

Fasola was on for a couple of years. Yeah. Let's see. In fact, when he first came down, he replaced the kind of band. And I wondered why they even put him on. I didn't think he was that good. You didn't think Fasola was that good? No. He went out to get a boy, a regular boy was sick, and Dan had Fasola come down. We didn't like him too much. We didn't think he didn't fit in with the band very well. But later on, he was also really good. I don't want to develop, but I guess it was at the time we didn't realize…
